title: Straight Roller Table
description: Original static freestanding straight roller table with thirteen separate thick hollow transverse rollers, thirteen axles and twenty-six genuinely bored bearing blocks on two parallel side beams. Each faceted axle rests on finite lower bore faces in both supports; each hollow roller rests by its finite upper bore face on its axle. Actual nonzero contact areas, roller gaps and frame clearances are checked. Four legs, four finite ground pads, two lower longitudinal ties and two transverse stretchers form a complete static support path. Open ends are plain terminations without coupling hardware or compatibility claims. Sixty-six individually editable closed meshes, four constant solid PBR materials, metres, native Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. No textures, labels, cargo or external assets. One fixed stylized visual prop only; no conveying, roller rotation, friction, drive, electrical operation, load rating, human use, equipment compatibility, manufacture or safety certification.
